query: What total scan counts and per-pathology case targets (nodule, ILD, pneumonia, emphysema) are required to achieve 80–90% power for prespecified non-inferiority margins in retrospective and prospective studies?

response.query: What total scan counts and per-pathology case targets (nodule, ILD, pneumonia, emphysema) are required to achieve 80–90% power for prespecified non-inferiority margins in retrospective and prospective studies?
response.answer: To achieve 80–90% power for non-inferiority margins, retrospective studies typically require 100–200 cases per pathology, while prospective studies need 150–300 cases per pathology. Specific counts depend on effect size and variability.
